course: This course helps graduate students produce relevant and appropriately styled material for their thesis. This course really helped me develop better study and writing habits and feel in control of my overall writing project. As I came from another discipline, I also learned to use APA style and departmental thesis format from scratch. The balance between lecture input and learner-focused class activities was ideal, and this helped us to internalise the main messages about genre and style requirements. The scheduling of the course was effective: the pace of work was tough in the first two-thirds of the course, with weekly assignments and monthly assessments, but this eased off towards the end once we had developed regular work habits and material that could be shaped and polished. Jennie adapted the course and assessment plan to the needs of a mixed-level MA and PhD group, and was careful to promote regular communication with our supervisors. Your thesis and writing will benefit a lot from taking this course!
